title: Control and Supervision of Consumer Protection Authorities

content.scenario: The Director-General of the Central Consumer Protection Authority has appointed an Additional Director-General to oversee consumer protection in a particular region. The Additional Director-General wants to exercise his powers independently.
content.outcome: The Additional Director-General shall exercise his powers and discharge his functions subject to the general control, supervision, and direction of the Director-General. This means that the Director-General has oversight and control over the actions of the Additional Director-General.

user_queries: Who controls the consumer protection authorities?
Can the Additional Director-General act independently?
What is the role of the Director-General in consumer protection?
